اعترضتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَرَضْتُنَّ (iʕtaraḍtunna) /iʕ.ta.radˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# اُعْتُرِضْتُنَّ (uʕturiḍtunna) /uʕ.tu.ridˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
